Project 'File Splitter For AI Upload' initialized. System requirements:
1. Core C++ Stream Splitting Engine (ByLines, ByCharacters, fixed 64KB buffer, UTF-8 codepoint boundary protection, subfolder generation).
2. Win32 Native Desktop Layout adhering strictly to EliteSoftwareTech Co. threads.subject: Milestone 3 & 4 Win32 GUI & Logger Handoff
threads.content:
GUI & AESTHETICS IMPLEMENTATION SUMMARY:
- 56px Title Banner painted with etched 3D bottom separator (DrawEdge) and Segoe UI Semibold 12pt title.
- Sunken 3D active area (WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE) for inputs, options, progress bar, and listview.
- 48px Darker Chin panel painted with RGB(224, 224, 224) (#E0E0E0) and etched top separator.
- Button Nomenclature strictly labeled 'Okay', 'Cancel', 'Apply', 'Exit', 'Done' (NEVER 'OK').
- Hover Tooltips (TTS_BALLOON / TOOLTIPS_CLASSW) registered on ALL interactive controls with witty/sarcastic copy.

- Async Processing: std::thread background worker posting WM_SPLIT_PROGRESS & WM_SPLIT_COMPLETE.
- Logger: System logger appending to %SystemDrive%\EliteSoftware\Logs\FileSplitter.log with Notepad viewer link.
- Compilation: windres res/FileSplitter.rc -O coff -o res/FileSplitter.res.o; g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -mwindows -municode FileSplitter.exe compiled cleanly.
